messages:
jamie (partnerships): Saturn SI will start pushing daily hardware usage to our marketplace webhook. Need to agree schema, idempotency, timezone normalization, and entitlement mapping. cc @lara @alex

lara (eng-partner): Please share a sample payload and signing method. We'll require retries, idempotency semantics, and a SKU->plan mapping.

marco (Saturn SI): sample payload (we'll POST per-cluster daily):
```json
{
  "device_id": "saturn-7a2",
  "customer_external_id": "acct_98765",
  "sku": "HW-PREM-8GPU",
  "units": 12,
  "usage_window_start": "2026-02-28T00:00:00-05:00",
  "usage_window_end": "2026-02-28T23:59:59-05:00",
  "reported_at_utc": "2026-02-29T04:00:12Z",
  "idempotency_token": "evt_20260229_0001",
  "sequence_per_device": 1234
}
```

alex (finance): We need canonical UTC day boundaries for billing. Also require a 14-day backfill window for corrections and an invoice_reference on replays.

infra-bot: Contract: POST /v1/marketplace/usage -> 200 within 10s. HMAC header: X-Saturn-Signature:sha256=<sig>. Retries: exponential, max 6. Dedup: idempotency_token + device_id + reported_at_utc.

lara (eng-partner): SKU->plan mapping: provide CSV with columns: saturn_sku,redwood_plan_id,unit_type,conversion_factor. Unit types: hours,units,tokens.

billing-team (ops): For reconciliation we need per-event units, UTC timestamp, external_customer_id, resolved_redwood_plan_id, raw_sku, and invoice_reference for corrections.

jamie (partnerships): Marco, confirm sequence_per_device is monotonic and corrections reuse idempotency_token with correction=true.

marco (Saturn SI): Confirmed. sequence monotonic. Corrections will include "correction": true and original idempotency_token; we'll provide invoice_reference when issued.

lara (eng-partner): Action items: (1) Saturn to send full SKU->plan CSV, (2) Saturn to publish HMAC signing doc and public key, (3) Infra to publish endpoint contract + test harness. I'll own validation tests. :thumbsup: 

jamie (partnerships): Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 10am PT with Saturn + infra + billing to finalize contract and recon window. :calendar:
